notes: Paper reports several limits: solar axions (g_ae vs g_agamma), neutrino magnetic moment, ALP DM (g_ae vs mass, panel c), and dark photon DM (chi vs mass, panel d). Extracted the ALP dark matter axion-electron coupling limit (Fig 6c), which is a bosonic DM absorption search with local density ~0.3 GeV/cm^3. Numerical values are approximate, read from the exclusion plot (no data table given); coupling range roughly 1e-14 to 1e-11 over masses (1,39) and (44,140) keV, with a gap at (39,44) keV due to unconstrained 83mKr. Note: paper also sets a flat solar-axion g_ae limit valid up to ~100 eV/c^2 and a dark photon DM limit which could alternatively be extracted as DarkPhoton. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 10))
